name: Poison Sting
description: Attacks leave poison on the target for %duration% turns, dealing %dmg_per_duration% damage for every turn still remaining on it.
details: Attacking an already-poisoned target extends the poison instead of restacking it.

upgrade.summary: Each turn of poison left also adds %vulnerability_per_stack% to the damage the victim takes.
details: Attacking an already-poisoned target extends the poison instead of restacking it.
Every turn still on the poison adds %vulnerability_per_stack% damage to everything that hits the victim, so the same stacks that are killing them are also softening them up.
